title: Typed accepted Ribasim surface-water head provenance

parent_candidate.status: PA01 candidate gate PASS; independent VQ pending at preregistration time

authorities.provenance_pattern: RM10 typed origin-bound Ribasim realization receipt
authorities.scheduling: RM11/RM12 coupler-owned allocation-boundary scheduler and exact-release trajectory

problem: PA01 deliberately accepts detached numeric head values as already-accepted application-boundary inputs. That is sufficient for the bounded SWAP-side profile but insufficient for an end-to-end SWAP5+Ribasim production claim because stale, trial, wrong-origin, wrong-revision, wrong-window or wrong-node head vectors are not type-detectable.

admission_target.purpose: Bind each surface-water head vector consumed by PA01 to one coupler-owned accepted Ribasim origin and coupling boundary, without making SWAP owner of Ribasim state.
admission_target.intended_composition: typed receipt -> validated PA02 binding -> existing PA01 profile wrapper -> Q4B-qualified signed exchange transaction

required_fields: accepted state time or exact coupling-boundary time
receipt_contract.head_unit: cm at the PA01/SWAP boundary; any Ribasim SI conversion occurs before receipt construction and is independently checked
receipt_contract.cardinality: one head per configured PA01 drainage-response level after explicit mapping; no implicit broadcasting
receipt_contract.persistence: receipt may be retained as accepted provenance metadata; it does not duplicate Basin storage or hydraulic state evolution

construction_rules: Construct only from an accepted Ribasim/coupler state, never directly from a trial candidate.
Ribasim origin id must be positive and accepted revision nonnegative.
Coupling interval must be finite with t1>t0.
Accepted state time must equal the boundary time required by the declared coupling contract within the existing generic time comparison rule.
Mapping id and ordered node ids must be explicit and stable; node-order permutation is a provenance mismatch, not a harmless reshape.
Git SHA must match the admitted Ribasim release for the profile.
Construction is deterministic for identical accepted origin, mapping and head values.
consumption_rules: PA02 may call PA01 only if receipt lineage, Ribasim origin/revision, interval, mapping and configured level count match the active coupled window.
The PA01 raw-head API remains a lower-level bounded boundary, but the full end-to-end route must not expose detached raw heads to orchestration.
A stale or future Ribasim revision fails before SWAP physical solve.
A wrong interval or skipped RM11/RM12 allocation boundary fails before SWAP physical solve.
A mapping or node-order mismatch fails before SWAP physical solve.
A rejected coupled attempt does not mutate the accepted receipt or accepted Ribasim revision.
Same accepted origins and same window must reproduce the same receipt and PA01 input vector.
minimum_tests: valid accepted receipt binds one-level and multi-level head vectors exactly
rejected PA01 process leaves receipt and both accepted revisions unchanged
restart reconstructs accepted receipt metadata and cannot replay a superseded revision
relationship_to_rm10: Reuse RM10's typed provenance pattern and fail-closed matching logic. Do not reuse irrigation-depth fields or claim RM10 receipt itself represents surface-water state.
relationship_to_rm11_rm12: The receipt time/window must be compatible with the coupler-owned accepted boundary sequence. PA02 does not create another scheduler.
nonclaims: No change to Ribasim allocation semantics.
No new surface-water storage in SWAP.
No automatic SWMAN=2 implementation inside SWAP.
No canonical admission until PA01 independent qualification is green and PA02 has separate candidate plus independent qualification.
